business: Passion4Growth: New-Market Sprint for logistics, wholesale and manufacturing companies in CEE (meetings with buyers in a new country or segment), run on the P4G outreach skill pack
target: Owners, CEOs and commercial directors of logistics/3PL, wholesale/distribution and manufacturing/export companies in Bulgaria and CEE with roughly EUR 2-50M revenue, whose new business depends on referrals, trade fairs and the owner's network
where: Bulgaria, Romania, Greece and the wider CEE region

segments.name: Owner of a wholesaler or distributor (EUR 2-10M revenue)
Commercial director at a manufacturer or exporter (EUR 10-50M revenue)
Founder or commercial director of a logistics, 3PL or freight forwarding firm

behaviours.name: Burned by an agency or consultant before
behaviours.how: Paid for strategy or lead generation that delivered slides or nothing; now wants proof before paying.

behaviours.name: Relationship seller
behaviours.how: Wins business through referrals, fairs and personal calls; doubts a system can replace that.

behaviours.name: Numbers-first
behaviours.how: Asks for cost per meeting, payback and what exactly is delivered before anything else.

behaviours.name: DIY tinkerer
behaviours.how: Has tried Apollo, Lemlist, a freelancer or an in-house SDR and thinks it can be done cheaper.

behaviours.name: Growth-hungry, entering a new market
behaviours.how: Has a concrete plan to grow into a new country or segment and needs a pipeline there.

behaviours.name: Allergic to buzzwords
behaviours.how: Ignores anything that sounds like consulting jargon; wants plain words about what happens.

behaviours.name: Slow committee decider
behaviours.how: Needs a partner or board to sign off on any new spend.

objections: Revenue architecture sounds like a consulting buzzword; what do I actually get?
I need clients, not another strategy deck
I paid an agency before and got nothing
We could buy Apollo and hire a junior SDR for less
Cold outreach could hurt our name or bring GDPR trouble
My team has no time to work on this with you
habits: you get three or four cold LinkedIn pitches a week from agencies
you exhibit at one or two trade fairs a year
your sales team is two or three people who mostly look after existing accounts
you approve every spend over EUR 1,000 yourself
you plan to enter a new country next year
last quarter two of your bigger customers cut their orders
